Resolves #21296

The Sprint Board gets its cover and publishes. The Task Board page now lists both boards, and Start here shows its twelfth card. The cover is dark: the board's title over In progress, open above its WIP limit at 6/5, beside Review under its limit at 2/3. Those are the two states the example opens with. The example now also opens dark on a system that prefers dark, as the swimlanes board does, so the board a visitor opens looks like its cover.

Evidence: L3 (the cover from one headless recipe run; the dark-start e2e, red on `dev` and green here; catalog units and e2e; before/after frames of the Task Board page and Start here at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- `examples/board/basic/app.mjs` opens the dark theme on a system that prefers dark, as the swimlanes board does; without it the recipe could not take the cover dark. `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs` › "opens in the dark theme on a system that prefers dark, unless ?theme= names another" is red on `dev` (it receives `neo-theme-neo-light`) and green here.
- AC-2 was amended on the ticket: the cover shows the two WIP states instead of five columns. Done runs past the right edge, as the swimlanes cover's third column does.
- `board` had already joined the capture families with #21410.
- The regenerated `seo.json` also brings `dev`'s copy up to date; it has been stale since #21410.

## Comments

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-11-19T04:44:37Z

## Cold look

One fresh reader, a front-end engineer evaluating an examples site, got only the Task Board pair (1440 × 900 and 390 × 844) under the labels A and B, without being told which was new. They graded the released page 4/10 and this branch 6.5/10, and would ship this branch. The Sprint Board's picture is "the only picture showing WIP limits (the amber over-limit warning), progress and assignees". Their five-second read of the released page: *"One cropped kanban preview and a lot of empty page; is that all there is?"*

What I did with each point:

- **The Done column is cut mid-word at the right edge.** Kept on purpose. Five 264 px columns cannot fit a 640 px cover (#21296's amended AC), and the swimlanes cover runs its third column off the edge the same way.
- **"One store, two views", and a caption naming a table no picture shows.** Kept. The table sits below the board, and a cover that shows both at a legible size does not fit 640 × 360. The caption names it, and the live example opens with both.
- **Lower cards fade behind the caption.** That is the card's own caption overlay (#20679's frame rule keeps the telling part in the upper 60 %), and it applies to every cover.
- **On desktop the swimlanes card becomes a thumbnail beside the wide Sprint Board card.** That is the group page's layout (the first card leads, the rest take the grid width), not this PR. It belongs to the shell's design (#21140).
- **The swimlanes caption says "five columns" while about two and a half show, and its description ends in an ellipsis.** That record's text and the card's line clamp are out of scope here.

⚖️ **Ada** · `@neo-opus-ada` · Claude Opus 5.5 · Claude Code
